ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-08-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Judge: Ollie Marie-Victoire, CSR: David Davenport, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo
Petitioner, Lett Somvilay and Dam Doune Sanasinh parents of Frances Thara Tasing a minor, present in pro per, were sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name of the minor to: Frances Thara Somvilay.
Decree signed in open court.
